manifest.claim_text: Individualization claim is controlled for. Primary metric: Incremental log score, calibration, decision utility and drift.
manifest.falsified_by: The mandatory control (Population, session-adapted, anatomy-only and longitudinal-person models; new session and novel task/intervention holdouts) shows the result survives only without it.
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Minimum interpretation enforced: Including a person's scan is not personalization unless it improves their future predictions beyond population and session baselines
non_goals: This gate does not claim a validated digital twin of any specific person.
This gate does not claim that any admitted operator is neurally realized.
No prospective human TMS/tFUS protocol is implemented or implied (build order stops at item 5; item 6 is out of scope: no IRB, no consent, no participants).
